This is the input side of the 'charge → plan → release' pipeline: a plan is later committed against this charge, and work units enqueued against it are released against a `WorkPool` in CPT priority order. A bucket may optionally name a `sku` and a `pickUnit` (`EACH` | `CASE`) for a pack-aware estimate (ADR-0045): `quantity` stays in eaches and the response bucket adds `handles`, `cubeMm3` and `weightG` from the SKU's local pack copy. <Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Receive a charge forecast for a process path"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/paths/{pathId}/charge"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Records the volume due by CPT for a process path — the ReceiveChargeForecast use case. Replaces any existing forecast for the path with the new set of CPT buckets (each bucket is an exact CPT timestamp and the quantity due at that CPT). Publishes `ChargeForecastReceived`. This is the input side of the "charge → plan → release" pipeline: a plan is later committed against this charge, and work units enqueued against it are released against a `WorkPool` in CPT priority order. A bucket may optionally name a `sku` and a `pickUnit` (`EACH` | `CASE`) for a pack-aware estimate (ADR-0045): `quantity` stays in eaches and the response bucket adds `handles`, `cubeMm3` and `weightG` from the SKU's local pack copy. A plain bucket is unchanged.

<ParamsDetails
  parameters={[{"name":"pathId","in":"path","required":true,"description":"The process path's identifier — a named station that owns a queue (unit-in → unit-out), e.g. a pick zone or pack line. Must belong to a process-path family declared in this deployment's process-path catalogue (ADR-0012; today the fleet's sortable-fc topology declares the pick/pack/rebin/slam families, each optionally carrying a \"-\"-delimited station/zone suffix, e.g. pick-a or pack-station-1). The write endpoints (receiveChargeForecast, commitShiftPlan, enqueueWorkUnit) reject ids outside the declared families with `400 unknown-path-id`; read endpoints surface a missing pool/projection as `404` instead.\n","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"pattern":"^(pick|pack|rebin|slam)(-.*)?$"},"example":"pick-a"}]}
>
  
</ParamsDetails>
